name: people_analytics_content_firehose
title: Analytics on people, firehose on content
expect: Person Chunked; Post/Comment Condensed props + Split adjacency; Tag/Place Split; Forum any
why: the reads walk knows lists and scan Person names (both want Chunked); the inserts append to the hub lists of other edge types: hasTag, isLocatedIn, hasCreator (these want Split: under Condensed an isLocatedIn list part averages {loc_part} to rewrite per insert; containerOf and replyOf lists are small, so their layout barely matters). Message properties are both read (point_post) and written (the inserts), but Condensed wins both sides (1 GET to read, 1 PUT to write). So a mixed layout takes each side's best layout at no cost.

why_scale_free.1: a Condensed row is one key, read with one GET and written with one PUT
